thread:
Sam (sales-eng): Heads up - starting POC kickoff with NorthStarFS tomorrow. They want locked-down access: SSO-only invites, SCIM sync, and ephemeral service accounts for CI. Also asking about Dedicated pool trial and whether we can separate billing from inference admin.
Alex (infra): We can create workspace-scoped invites that disable static API keys and require ephemeral tokens. SCIM group sync supports auto-mapping groups -> roles; include `scim_group` in invite to auto-assign.
Priya (security): They also requested a minimal least-privilege role matrix. We usually do: `billing-view`, `svc-inference` (create ephemeral tokens, submit inference calls), `model-uploader` (if they will upload private models), and `viewer`. No one gets `workspace-admin` except the POC owner.
Mateo (acct exec): Pricing note: they estimated 30k tokens/day, 14 days. For Dedicated trial we can offer a 2-week small reserved pool with a prorated commit or let them use hosted with burst credits. Which is cheaper depends on token shapes and concurrency.
Jordan (solutions): If they expect peaks ~200 rps for short tests, Dedicated is recommended. Otherwise hosted is simpler. We'll ask for example request size distribution and QPS.
Sam (sales-eng): Can we give them a one-liner invite payload for automated provisioning? They want to script invites from their admin console.
Alex (infra): Example payload below - SCIM-friendly minimal invite JSON to create a temporary svc account that expires after 7 days:

```json
{
  "email": "poc-bot@northstarfs.com",
  "display_name": "NS POC Bot",
  "roles": ["svc-inference"],
  "scim_group": "poc-team",
  "metadata": {"env":"poc"},
  "expires_at": "2026-07-01T12:00:00Z"
}
```

Sam (sales-eng): Good. Also the customer asked about ephemeral token creation via CLI for their CI runner.
Alex (infra): CLI example (curl) to mint ephemeral token for svc-inference role (3600s TTL):

```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/workspaces/northstarfs/ephemeral_tokens \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"role":"svc-inference","ttl_seconds":3600}' | jq -r .token
```

Priya (security): We'll include a short checklist in the security questionnaire reply: require SAML with encrypted assertions, SCIM group mapping, disable static keys for POC workspace, option to restrict ephemeral token minting to specific IP ranges, and recommend KMS for Private if they plan to use customer data.
Mateo (acct exec): They also asked if we support separating billing from admin - yes, we can create a `billing-view` role scoped to billing info only.
Jordan (solutions): For Dedicated trials infra needs: GPU SKU (A10G/NVIDIA X2?), expected concurrency, average token length, and model version. If they want quantized weights to reduce cost we can provide profiles.
Sam (sales-eng): Action items: Alex - send invite JSON + CLI token example; Priya - draft questionnaire reply and role matrix; Jordan - draft Dedicated trial delta pricing; Mateo - confirm billing separation details and schedule intro call.
Alex (infra): Posting the IAM snippet for role-to-SAML mapping to hand off to their SSO team:

scim_group -> role mapping example:
- `poc-engineers` -> `svc-inference`
- `poc-admins` -> `workspace-admin` (avoid unless absolutely needed)
- `finance` -> `billing-view`

sre-bot: Onboarding link created: https://console.redwood.ai/onboard/northstarfs (valid 6 days) :link:

Priya (security): Also add note: if they migrate to Private/VPC later, we require KMS policy statement and network ranges for peering. Recommend starting with hosted + strict SSO and move to Private only if regulated data is introduced.

Mateo (acct exec): I scheduled the kickoff, invited their infra lead. Will follow up with pricing email.

Sam (sales-eng): Thanks team. I'll send them the invite template and loop back with any follow-ups here. :rocket:
